en.headline: Government aims to table building and fire law changes by year end
en.dek: Officials told lawmakers they plan to widen building-law amendments and revise the Fire Services Ordinance, with drafts targeted before the end of the year.
body: The government aims to put legislative proposals on building repairs and fire installations before the Legislative Council by the end of this year, officials said during Friday's debate on the five-year plan and the Policy Address.

Development Bureau chief Bernadette Linn said the government would do more on old-district renewal, rebuilding and repair of ageing blocks, widen the scope of amendments to the Buildings Ordinance, tighten regulation of the industry and raise penalties for breaches. She said the target was to submit the proposals by the end of the year, RTHK reported.

Security Bureau chief Chris Tang said the authorities would amend the Fire Services Ordinance to strengthen the regulatory regime for fire installations, introduce a responsible-person system for those installations, and raise penalties. He said the draft amendment bill was targeted for submission to the legislature before the end of the year.

Linn also said a risk-based programme would replace or repair 350 kilometres of older water mains with a higher leak risk within five years, about double the current replacement volume. She said a package of measures would be set out to the Legislative Council's development panel by the end of this year, with funding sought from the Finance Committee next year.

zh.headline: 政府目標年底提交建築物及消防條例修訂
zh.dek: 發展局及保安局向立法會表示，將擴大建築物條例修訂範圍，並修訂消防條例，目標今年底提交建議。
body: 官員周五在立法會辯論五年規劃及施政報告時表示，有關樓宇維修及消防裝置的修例建議，目標在今年年底前提交立法會。
港台引述發展局局長甯漢豪說，政府會做好舊區活化、舊樓重建和維修，擴大《建築物條例》修訂範圍，加強對業界的規管和違規懲罰，提升專業操守，目標是今年年底提交立法建議。
保安局局長鄧炳強表示，當局會修訂《消防條例》，強化消防裝置的規管制度，引入消防裝置責任人制度，並提升罰則和刑責，目標是年底前向立法會提交修訂條例草案。
甯漢豪又說，未來五年會以風險為本更換或修復共350公里滲漏風險較高的高齡水管，更換量較現時約多一倍。她表示，目標今年年底向立法會發展事務委員會匯報一籃子措施的詳細部署，明年向財委會申請撥款。
